listing.name: Vertical Bar Agent
listing.description: Inspect authorized NetSuite snapshots and process data, publish grounded Briefings, and manage Test Suites and release workflows. Author and publish Stress Test contracts, open their CrossCheck page to start a Run, and inspect Run progress and results. Agent-started Stress Test runs are available only in active sandbox or release-preview environments. Shopify tools read snapshots and records with personal data excluded, start snapshots, restore selected objects, execute saved sync definitions and manage runs. Both Shopify write tools require fresh host interaction; server authorization remains authoritative. Restore may create gift cards or credit/debit gift-card and store-credit balances. Sync rejects GiftCard writes and keeps store-credit balances. Saved syncs configured to update existing orders can record manual payments or capture/void an existing target-order payment authorization when transactions are selected; the selected effects are disclosed before confirmation.

remoteConnector.testPolicy: Use a populated dedicated non-customer reviewer account. Record successful live tool exercises and authorization refusals truthfully; fixture checks alone are not live dogfood.
remoteConnector.executionBoundary: The hosted MCP runtime resolves fresh authorized environment metadata on every start and rejects production, development, inactive, unknown or unverified targets before dispatch. Stress Test starts check the selected environment; CI workflow starts check every stage. Agents never start Test Suite runs: a read-only handoff returns the CrossCheck page where the user starts one. Skills also refuse delegated, direct API or browser-click workarounds. Users execute production runs themselves in the CrossCheck product UI. Authoring, preview, publishing, observation and explicitly requested Stress Run cancellation remain available.
remoteConnector.shopifyBoundary: Shopify write tools require cc.read and cc.write plus server-authorized access; Restore is limited to owner/admin. Read responses exclude personal data and fail closed without a runtime marker. Shopify is separate from the NetSuite execution-policy restriction. Version 0.15.3 is prepared for resubmission; submission and Publish update remain human actions.

toolAnnotationNotes.screen_open: screen_open is readOnlyHint true, destructiveHint false, openWorldHint false (owner decision, RND-6352): it sends the screen only to the signed-in user's own open CrossCheck tabs and always returns its link, and stores or changes no CrossCheck, NetSuite or Shopify data; a tab with unsaved edits waits instead of moving.
toolAnnotationNotes.cc_preview_stress_test: cc_preview_stress_test stays readOnlyHint true with the optional testRef: the preview is compiled and shown on the user's open screen of that test (Keep or Discard there); nothing is stored by this call.
